display.title: Episode 142: The Hour of Fortune (Before Rosh Hashanah)
display.summary_short: A loyal servant gets one hour in the king's treasure room but wastes it listening to a violinist: a parable about using our time for mitzvos and ignoring the yetzer hara.
display.summary_long: With Rosh Hashanah coming next Thursday and Friday, Uncle Yossi invites listeners to greet the King in the field with joy and the Hakochainik march, followed by a sponsor message. A boy of almost five tells what he is learning in yeshiva and leads the Shema. Before story time Uncle Yossi explains that life in this world is for a limited time, and that the only way to defeat the yetzer hara is to ignore it. The story, 'The Hour of Fortune,' tells of Yisroel, the king's most devoted servant, who is rewarded with one hour in the royal treasure room to take whatever he wishes. He brings ten large barrels, but the king places a violinist in the room to test him, and each time Yisroel turns to the diamonds the musician plays a finer piece. When the hour ends, he leaves with empty barrels. Uncle Yossi explains that the King is Hashem, the treasure room is this world, the treasures are mitzvos, and the violinist is the yetzer hara. The show ends with the Shofar Gadol contest and a surprise guest promised for next week.
display.lesson: Our time in this world is a precious hour for gathering mitzvos; don't let the yetzer hara's 'music' distract you, just ignore it.

date.note: On air: 'Rosh Hashanah is next Thursday and Friday.' Rosh Hashanah 5745 fell on Thu-Fri 27-28 Sep 1984, so the Tuesday broadcast is 18 Sep 1984.
